= AWS StepFunctions
:artifactid: camel-aws2-step-functions-starter

Manage the state machines and activities of AWS Step Functions, and start, stop and inspect their executions.

== What's inside

* xref:{csb-camel-components}::aws2-step-functions-component.adoc[AWS StepFunctions component], URI syntax: `aws2-step-functions:label`

Please refer to the above links for usage and configuration details.

== Maven coordinates

[source,xml]
----
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.camel.springboot</groupId>
    <artifactId>camel-aws2-step-functions-starter</artifactId>
</dependency>
----
